content.short: Optix is an altcoin option protocol that lets users trade options on any crypto asset.
content.description: Optix enables options on altcoins by letting any ERC-20 token serve as collateral and any price oracle determine the strike price. A single collateral vault can back option selling across multiple oracles, covering both put and call directions, expiries, and strikes. The platform emphasizes a simple user experience, making options trading more approachable. It supports permissionless structured products built from existing DeFi primitives and permissioned DeFi for regulated participants, plus block trading for assets with KYC’d participants.
